chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, and Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Bundar, from his father, and Ahmad ibn Abu Abdullah, all from Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Hamadani, similar to it.

Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ibrahim ibn Abd al-Hamid, who said: 'I heard Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) saying: 'Adhere to eating fish, for if you eat it without bread, it will suffice you, and if you eat it with bread, it will fill you up.'
ai.seo_question: What are the dietary benefits and satiating properties of fish according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) highlights the nutritional efficacy of fish, noting its ability to satisfy hunger either alone or in combination with bread. This advice reflects the practical wisdom of the Ahl al-Bayt regarding dietary health and sustenance, emphasizing fish as a wholesome and efficient food source within the Shia tradition.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, and Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Bundar, from his father and Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, altogether from Muhammad Bin Ali Al Hamdany – similar to it.

Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ibrahim Bin Abdul Hameed who said, 
‘I heard Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘It is on you with (eating) the fish, for if you were to eat it without bread, it would suffice you, and if you eat it with bread, it would fill you up’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Ibrahim ibn ‘Abd al-Hamid who has said the following: I once heard abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying, ‘You must eat fish; if you eat it without bread it is sufficient; and if you eat with bread it becomes more palatable for you.’”
